t: How to Choose MCB: An MCB Selection Guide
s: June 26, 2024 - Residential MCBs commonly have voltage ratings of either 240 volts (V) or 415 V. MCBs rated at 240 V are suitable for single-phase electrical systems, commonly found in household environments. Conversely, MCBs with a 415 V rating are intended for three-phase systems, typical in commercial and industrial settings. It’s essential that the MCB’s voltage rating is equal to or exceeds the nominal voltage of the circuit it is protecting.
